question: Who are the top 10 key figures or founders in Quantum Sensing? Give me 100 word explanation and the rank
answer:
Here are ten key figures—pioneers and founders—who have made foundational contributions to the field of quantum sensing, ranked by their impact:

1. Jörg Wrachtrup – Pioneered optically detected magnetic resonance on single spins and nanoscale quantum sensing using nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%B6rg_Wrachtrup?utm_source=openai)).  
2. Ania Bleszynski Jayich – Developed novel quantum sensing and imaging techniques using NV centers and hybrid quantum systems ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ania_Bleszynski_Jayich?utm_source=openai)).  
3. Franz Josef Giessibl – Invented the qPlus sensor for atomic force microscopy, enabling subatomic resolution and quantum-level force sensing ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Franz_Josef_Giessibl?utm_source=openai)).  
4. Federico Capasso – Co‑invented the quantum cascade laser, a key tool in quantum-enhanced spectroscopy and sensing ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federico_Capasso?utm_source=openai)).  
5. Brenton Young & Mark Kasevich (AOSense founders) – Founded AOSense, a leading company in atom‑optic quantum sensors for navigation and gravity measurement ([v-mr.biz](https://v-mr.biz/quantum-sensors-market?utm_source=openai)).  
6. Graeme Malcolm & Gareth Maker (M Squared Lasers founders) – Built systems enabling quantum accelerometers, clocks, and sensors ([quantum.org.uk](https://quantum.org.uk/categories/quantum-sensing/?utm_source=openai)).  
7. Markus Mangold, Andreas Hugi & Markus Geiser (IRsweep founders) – Commercialized quantum‑cascade‑laser‑based spectroscopy for sensing applications ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IRsweep?utm_source=openai)).  
8. Vector Atomic founders – Developed cold‑atom interferometry quantum inertial navigation systems ([quantum.org.uk](https://quantum.org.uk/tags/sensing/?utm_source=openai)).  
9. Alex Mairean (Phantom Photonics CEO) – Leading development of ultra‑sensitive quantum sensors capable of single‑photon detection ([phys.org](https://phys.org/news/2026-01-stealth-quantum-sensors-possibilities-gps.html?utm_source=openai)).  
10. Seth Lloyd – Theoretical pioneer whose work spans quantum sensing, defining fundamental limits and algorithms ([iankhan.com](https://www.iankhan.com/worlds-top-innovators-in-quantum-computing-and-advanced-computing/?utm_source=openai)).

Each of these individuals or teams has significantly advanced quantum sensing—whether through groundbreaking experimental techniques, enabling technologies, or commercialization of quantum sensors.
